name: lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP-backed IDA function; raw function chunk independently rehashed against the pinned AP. See evidence bundle for chunk hash and recovered control flow.

notes: Returns display+4 when display+756 has rotation bit 2, otherwise display+0. A null argument falls back to *0x200bd200; returns zero if no display. This is not a raw fixed-axis field accessor. UI-owner context only; physical display validation remains pending.
